test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A sound that cannot be heard
solution:
The correct answer is '**Inaudible**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Inaudible**'.
 
• It means 'not loud enough to be heard'. (जो जल्‍दी या आसानी से सुनाई न पड़े, कष्‍टश्राव्‍य; अश्रव्‍य)
 
 
• *Example: She spoke so quietly that she was almost **inaudible**.*<
